summary: New Found Gold Corp. closed a bought-deal public offering of 38,870,000 common shares at C$2.96 per share, inclusive of the underwriters' over-allotment exercise, for gross proceeds of C$115.1 million. Led by BMO Capital Markets and SCP Resource Finance, the syndicate included several other underwriters. Proceeds will fund the 100%-owned Queensway Gold Project and general corporate purposes. The offering included insider participation by Eric Sprott (~19% stake) and certain officers/directors, exempt from MI 61-101 minority approval. The TSX Venture Exchange final approval is pending. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation.
